title: The intuitionistic Hintikka extension lemma omits unused parameters.
details: In the2015 handout8, Chapter11 Lemma2.4 p.8 asserts a Hintikka extension relative to a universe U_infinity for every Gamma in a finite-character consistency property. Chapter10 Definition3.4 p.4 defines a universe to be nonempty with infinitely many unused parameters; Chapter11 Definition2.3(1) requires all parameters of the theory to lie in that universe. Let Gamma contain tP(c) for every parameter c. It belongs to the finite-character consistency property of classically satisfiable signed sets (a one-element model with P true witnesses this), but any universe supporting an extension of Gamma would contain every parameter, contradicting the definition. Repair: require Gamma to be supported on a universe with infinitely many unused parameters, as in the earlier classical Lemma3.5 and the enclosing intuitionistic Theorem2.2. The corpus retains that hypothesis and a fresh reserve throughout.
